''See also: [[Little Blue Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Little Blue is a naturally occurring [[spirit]] composed entirely of ocean-[[blue madra]]. Though she often appears as a small, featureless blue puppet or a tiny woman roughly the size of a hand, she possesses significant intelligence and can grow to human proportions. Her physical form is characterized by vivid blue colors, often resembling a sunlit lake or deep ocean, and she frequently manifests with flowing, dress-like lower body structures. Her appearance can fluctuate in color and transparency based on her well-being; for instance, she may turn pale or nearly white when exhausted or distressed, and can regain her deep azure hue by immersing herself in a [[Spirit Well]]. As a [[spirit]], Little Blue serves several vital roles. She possesses the ability to cleanse and pacify hostile elements within a person's [[spirit]], providing relief and soothing their channels through contact. She can also inhabit a person's [[soulspace]], where she occupies considerable spiritual weight. Beyond her restorative abilities, she demonstrates combat utility by utilizing techniques such as the [[Empty Palm]], the [[Soul Cloak]], and the [[Hollow Domain]]. She is also capable of manifesting complex environments, such as a primordial forest, to enhance existing landscapes. Communicating through a variety of chimes, whistles, chirps, and burbles, she often acts as an emotional companion, providing comfort to [[Lindon]] or warning others of approaching dangers.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Little Blue is a tiny [[spirit]] that resembles an ocean-blue woman, often appearing as a small creature reaching up to one foot in height. She has deep navy hair, pale blue opaque skin, and wears a [[sapphire]] dress made of ocean-[[blue madra]]. She is capable of manifesting into a larger, human-sized body.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A companion to [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]], this intelligent [[spirit]] is an expressive listener who communicates through chimes, whistles, and various melodic sounds. She is known to cheer, applaud, and provide encouragement, though she can also be impatient or berate others for refusing her help. While she has shown reluctance to fight certain powerful entities, she is a loyal partner to [[Orthos]] and frequently reacts emotionally to the events around her.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Little Blue has a contracted bond with [[Lindon]] and serves as his companion. She is also a companion to [[Yerin]], residing within her [[soulspace]]. Little Blue acts as a partner to [[Orthos]] and has provided care for [[Mercy]], [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], and [[Carmine]]. Additionally, she plays with [[Suriel's glass bead|Suriel's marble]], has trained [[Kelsa]], and was once held by [[Mercy]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Little Blue possesses a healing touch that can soothe spirits, reinforce [[madra channels]], and cleanse [[Blackflame aura]] buildup. She can manipulate power by absorbing spirits to grow stronger or using a [[Hollow Domain]] and the [[Empty Palm]] [[technique]] to strike enemies. Additionally, she can deflect [[madra]] attacks, disrupt spiritual power, and use [[pure madra]] to create protective walls.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Recovery and healing}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Little Blue is the [[Sylvan Riverseed]], a [[spirit]] appearing as a woman composed of deep [[blue madra]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c3">''Ghostwater'', chapter 3</ref> As [[Lindon]] requires her assistance to recover, this creature lives in a habitat of two halves lying in the sand.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c5">''Ghostwater'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref> The chirping entity scurried up [[Lindon]]'s back onto his head and later jumped upon [[Orthos]]' head.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8">''Ghostwater'', chapter 8</ref> Although she possesses a healing touch and can affect [[madra]], she is not in any shape to provide treatment for [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c9">''Ghostwater'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c12">''Ghostwater'', chapter 12</ref> This small, deep ocean blue [[spirit]] chimes like a bell and can cleanse or reinforce [[madra channels]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c13">''Ghostwater'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15">''Ghostwater'', chapter 15</ref> She is capable of flooding [[Orthos]] with power, though she once tumbled to the ground.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" /> Possessing a [[Highgold]] [[pure core]], the [[spirit]] can be stored in [[Lindon]]'s pocket or located in void storage before eventually crawling out of his pocket.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11">''Ghostwater'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16">''Ghostwater'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18">''Ghostwater'', chapter 18</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Accompanying Lindon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Little Blue is a tiny, six-inch-tall [[spirit]] shaped like a woman made of deep blue light who clings to [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c2">''Underlord'', chapter 2</ref> After being discovered inside a bundle of firewood within the [[void key]] space, this creature began accompanying [[Lindon]] and reacting to his surprises.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3">''Underlord'', chapter 3</ref> While playing with [[Suriel's glass bead|Suriel’s marble]], the [[Sylvan]] with an ocean-blue face would applaud or sit upon [[Lindon]]'s collar.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4">''Underlord'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c6">''Underlord'', chapter 6</ref> Small enough to be held in [[Lindon]]'s [[Remnant]] fingers, she has spent time in his pocket listening to his stories.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c7">''Underlord'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8">''Underlord'', chapter 8</ref> [[Lindon]] can cycle [[Heaven's Drop]] to her, though she sobs with a sound like pattering rain and is currently too weak to be unaffected by the [[boundary field]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c17">''Underlord'', chapter 17</ref> Though [[Lindon]] may ask her for help, she has simply gone with him.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c22">''Underlord'', chapter 22</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Little Blue is a naturally formed [[spirit]] of [[pure madra]] who sleeps in a flowerpot.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c10">''Wintersteel'', chapter 10</ref> During a match, she stood on [[Lindon]]'s head to watch before covering her eyes and leaning on his shoulder.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref> As a [[spirit]] capable of climbing on [[Lindon]]'s shoulder, she can produce a mournful flute note.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref> This intelligent creature can roll a [[scale]] across a desk.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9">''Wintersteel'', chapter 9</ref> She possesses ocean-blue hair, wears a [[sapphire]] dress, and is able to fly on a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c10" /> Kept inside [[Lindon's void key]], she channeled [[madra]] into the priest from his pocket and empowered his own [[pure madra]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13">''Wintersteel'', chapter 13</ref> She even berated [[Lindon]] for failing to accept her help.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14">''Wintersteel'', chapter 14</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Bloodline era}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Little Blue is a creature capable of communicating through a bond and the ringing of a bell, once letting out a loud peep.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4">''Bloodline'', chapter 4</ref> [[Lindon]] is able to slip the creature into his [[void key]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c7">''Bloodline'', chapter 7</ref> Standing one foot in height, Little Blue sits on a table or atop [[Orthos]]'s head, using chirps and ringing tones to communicate.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c8">''Bloodline'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9">''Bloodline'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15">''Bloodline'', chapter 15</ref> While traveling with [[Lindon]] and [[Orthos]], the creature issued a whistle of alarm.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c13">''Bloodline'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15" /> Little Blue has also seen to the recovery of [[Mercy]] and [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21">''Bloodline'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Companion in Reaper}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Little Blue is an ocean-blue woman about a foot tall who drives a small cloud and wears a dress made of ocean [[blue madra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2">''Reaper'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c6">''Reaper'', chapter 6</ref> A companion of [[Lindon]] who can whistle, she expressed reluctance to fight another [[Dreadgod]] and found that her attention was not enough to restore [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c4">''Reaper'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c6" /> As she grew addicted to training [[Kelsa]], she remained present with the group and once burbled that she did not feel well.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7">''Reaper'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref> She made a tinkling sound in agreement with [[Orthos]] and cheered at the thrill of the leap, prompting [[Lindon]] to reinforce his protection of her.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref> Though her voice rang with impatience and she whispered comfort to [[Lindon]], she was eventually missing from his shoulder.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12">''Reaper'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14">''Reaper'', chapter 14</ref> This high-level existence is a listener who clings to [[Orthos]]' back as his partner.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16">''Reaper'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17">''Reaper'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20">''Reaper'', chapter 20</ref> After [[Lindon]] hid her, she glared at him and cheered for the new hammer, though she rings like a bell when panicked.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19">''Reaper'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Captivity and terror}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|As one of the captives, Little Blue was being held by [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c24">''Reaper'', chapter 24</ref> After experiencing a sense of shock, the entity emitted an offended clang.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25">''Reaper'', chapter 25</ref> Little Blue trembled in terror when faced with [[Eithan]]'s true power, a shaking that sounded like the jingling of glass shards.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26">''Reaper'', chapter 26</ref> During this moment, Little Blue hugged [[Eithan]]'s shin.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Little Blue possesses the ability to purify the corruption within her own [[spirit]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> She can grow more powerful by consuming other spirits.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref> As a [[spirit]] residing within [[Yerin]]'s [[soulspace]], she is able to pull a [[hunger spears|hunger spear]] directly from [[Yerin]]'s soul.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9">''Dreadgod'', chapter 9</ref> When absorbing power, this [[spirit]] turns purple in color.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9" /> Additionally, Little Blue has the capacity to emerge from [[soulspace]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14">''Dreadgod'', chapter 14</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Companion of Yerin}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|As a companion to [[Yerin]], Little Blue is a [[spirit]] capable of experiencing both pain and fluctuations in power.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14" /> While her internal power clashes with a red light, she maintains an inner focus to cycle her [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14" /> Having been passed by the [[Blood Sage]], this creature once cooed a question toward [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref> Little Blue can whisper to [[Yerin]] from her shoulder and has made sounds like cheering frozen bells.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> She is able to run around on [[Orthos]]' head and cheer, even ringing out like a bell to wish [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] good luck.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Training with Lindon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Little Blue is a character who accompanies [[Lindon]] and [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], once even offering applause.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2">''Waybound'', chapter 2</ref> During training sessions, her body flickers purple, and she possesses the ability to inspire [[Orthos]] with her energy.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref> While [[Lindon]] worries she might only be following him due to his and [[Yerin]]'s wishes, this creature has demonstrated the ability to defend herself and [[Orthos]] by disrupting spiritual power and deflecting [[madra]] attacks.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref> Possessing a level comparable to an [[Archlord]], she was seen standing on [[Mercy]]'s stomach and later trained in a [[cycling]] position within the [[Blackflame cycling chamber]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13">''Waybound'', chapter 13</ref> She provides [[Orthos]] with constant encouragement during combat and uses her [[madra]] to flood his channels for cooling purposes.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13" /> Little Blue also used her abilities to open [[Lindon's void key]] to retrieve [[Archlord natural treasures]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13" /> A [[spirit]] capable of inhabiting the body of a grown human woman, she resembles a woman with deep navy hair and opaque, pale blue skin.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17">''Waybound'', chapter 17</ref> Having a contracted bond with [[Lindon]], she advanced to the rank of [[Herald]] when her [[spirit]] manifested physically into a body, radiating an [[aura]] of [[blood]] and dream.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Battle with Weeping Dragon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|During the clash against the [[Weeping Dragon]], Little Blue fought behind [[Lindon]] and [[Orthos]] while being pursued by a swarm of [[lightning-dragons]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref> Utilizing an [[Empty Palm]] the size of her new human body, she wiped out dozens of [[Striker techniques]] and struck the [[dragons|Dragon]] with her own [[Empty Palm]], both of which were magnified by [[Lindon's madra]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /> While [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] protected her from the [[Weeping Dragon]], Little Blue unleashed techniques to block the beast and held a copy of [[Dross]] in her hand.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> As [[Akura Malice]]'s shadows crept toward her, Little Blue worked on Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel's [[spirit]] and used [[pure madra]] to soothe [[Mercy]]'s cracked channels.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> Though she would have difficulty establishing [[Authority|authority]] over the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s [[binding]], Little Blue nodded at [[Lindon]]'s words.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref> No longer six inches tall, the [[spirit]] that had once cried with [[Mercy]] struggled against a [[Shadow|shadow]] [[sword]] and took a beating.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref> After using a [[Hollow Domain]], her [[spirit]] began to fade until she drew from [[Lindon]]'s cores.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref> Little Blue can use an [[Empty Palm]] [[technique]] and flanks [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Humanoid form}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|In her humanoid form, Little Blue possesses the ability to stand at a human height.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c37">''Waybound'', chapter 37</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">1</span></div>

</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Little Blue is a monster characterized by laughter that sounds like tinkling bells and snoring reminiscent of [[wind]] through silver leaves.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 11</ref> Capable of assuming a human-sized form and utilizing the [[Hollow Domain]], this creature communicates through the use of harsh chimes.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /> While present during the unloading of crates, Little Blue sat atop [[Orthos]]'s shell and was able to hold a feathered [[dragon]] with both hands.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /> In combat, Little Blue can crush techniques with sheer strength and [[pure madra]], utilizing an [[Empty Palm]] attack or providing protection for [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] and [[Carmine]] with a wall of blue-[[white power]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /> After placing a foot on [[G-42]]'s chest and whistling in triumph, Little Blue accompanied [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] on a mission.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> During this time, Little Blue cheered alongside [[Mercy]] and eventually flew away in excitement when [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] drifted off.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}
